Trial_Name: ProTECT III / SyNAPSe (Progesterone in Severe TBI)
Clinical_Outcome: FAILED / TERMINATED FOR FUTILITY (No GOSE benefit at 6 months)
Virtual_Biotech_Failure_Diagnosis: Low Subacute Specificity (tau_2 = 0.355) & Target Collapse: Pan-cellular progesterone receptor signaling and subacute loss of extrasynaptic GABRD tonic inhibition subunits prevent neurosteroid efficacy.

Virtual_Biotech_Failure_Diagnosis: Subpopulation Blindness (tau_2 = 0.365): Broadly suppressing all microglia in the chronic phase inhibits reparative clearance without unlocking astroglial or neuronal state lock-in.

Virtual_Biotech_Failure_Diagnosis: Compartment Bypass Failure (tau_2 = 0.350): Blocking peripheral leukocyte transmigration alone fails to silence CNS-resident activated microglia inside the brain parenchyma.
